No idea about ordering it, but the magazine
promo cards have always (as I recall) appeared
in the upcoming set. So a little patience will save
you some cash. Only differences as I recall was
that some claimed better card stock in those released
in magazines.

Prev examples: Lucita, Fatima, Hesha
Was Vitel released in a magazine? Can't remember.

The only non-set released promos were all
tournament/convention released.. no magazines:
Dan Murdock, Marianne Gilbert, Meddling of Sesmith,
Eye of Hazimel...

-JTP
